Langlands.IsArtinMap.frobenius.type:
∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K] {L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K)}
  {art : NumberField.IdeleClassGroup (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K →* Gal(↥L/K)},
  Langlands.IsArtinMap K L art →
    ∀ (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
      (w : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers ↥L)) [inst_2 : w.IsMaximal],
      w.LiesOver v.asIdeal →
        Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) w →
          ∀ (ϖ : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v)ˣ),
            Langlands.IsUniformizer ↑ϖ →
              IsArithFrobAt (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)
                (art ((NumberField.IdeleClassGroup.ofAdicCompletion (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) K v) ϖ))⁻¹ w

  Langlands.IsNormalizedEigenform f →
    ∀ (p r : ℕ),
      Nat.Prime p → p ∣ N → Langlands.qCoeff f (p ^ (r + 1)) = Langlands.qCoeff f p * Langlands.qCoeff f (p ^ r)

Langlands.IsNormalizedEigenform.good.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {k : ℤ} {f : CuspForm (Subgroup.map (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mapGL ℝ) (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N)) k},
  Langlands.IsNormalizedEigenform f →
    ∀ (p r : ℕ),
      Nat.Prime p →
        ¬p ∣ N →
          Langlands.qCoeff f (p ^ (r + 2)) =
            Langlands.qCoeff f p * Langlands.qCoeff f (p ^ (r + 1)) - ↑p ^ (k - 1) * Langlands.qCoeff f (p ^ r)

    ∀ (m n : ℕ), m.Coprime n → Langlands.qCoeff f (m * n) = Langlands.qCoeff f m * Langlands.qCoeff f n
